name: Siriporn Chaiwong
bio:
Siriporn's journey into motorsport began unconventionally. While her family expected her to pursue a career in traditional Thai medicine, she found herself drawn to the precision and engineering of engines. After secretly enrolling in a vocational program focused on automotive fabrication, she excelled, quickly becoming known for her meticulous welding and ability to diagnose complex mechanical issues. Her dedication led to an apprenticeship with a local racing team before landing a spot at Porsche Penske Motorsport.

Siriporn brings a pragmatic approach to her role, focusing on efficiency and reliability. She's known for her systematic problem-solving and unwavering commitment to quality. Her colleagues appreciate her calm demeanor under pressure and her ability to find practical solutions to challenging fabrication problems. While some might see her as reserved, her dedication to perfection and her methodical nature make her an invaluable asset to the team, ensuring every component meets the highest standards.

physical.hairStyle: Long, straight hair usually tied back in a neat ponytail
physical.description: She is of average height, with a slender build and a focused expression.

quirks: Always sharpens her welding tips before starting a new job.
Keeps a small collection of miniature race cars on her workbench.
Prefers to listen to traditional Thai folk music through noise-canceling headphones while working.
